summary: Revision 2, attempt 2: fixed the only open finding, REV-1. The three console.log debug leftovers in src/Plugins/SortPlugin.ts (lines 120/123/127) are removed with no behaviour change, and the regression guard test in src/Build.test.ts now cites requirement R1 instead of the unknown id QUAL-001 (the reason the previous attempt was rejected by the engine). Everything else from the accepted work stays exactly as before: package.json exports are split so each condition carries its own types (import -> ./dist/index.d.mts, require -> ./dist/index.d.ts, types first, no top-level types condition), the dead ./dist/*.css subpath export is removed, and "type": "commonjs" is added; rollup.config.js keeps the inline esmTypes writeBundle plugin that emits dist/index.d.mts with .js-extensioned relative specifiers and the "use client"; banner on both outputs. No public export, prop, type, dependency or check was changed. Verified: npm run type-check exits 0; npx jest src/Build.test.ts src/Package.test.ts passes 8/8 (build from a clean state, type-check, package validation, no FalseCJS, CJS entry not regressed).
